page.overview:
Who is Tamaoki?

Tamaoki is a tall and average sized man. He has short hair, faint eyebrows, several eyebags and a mole on his forehead.

He wears the standard Devil Hunter uniform.

Tamaoki is very serious about his duties and protecting Denji; he apologizes for using the boy as bait. He also demonstrates a strong knowledge base, easily identifying the identity and devil contract of one of the American assassins targeting Denji; the footsteps of humans converted into dolls by the Doll Devil; and Angel Devil's lifespan weapon. He states that the beings turned into dolls cannot be restored, which may demonstrate his pragmatism considering that Quanxi later tells Denji "ignorance is bliss", casting doubt on that claim about the dolls.

When Makima finds out that Denji's existence is revealed in the media, and that assassins from other countries will come to kill him, Makima orders her subordinates to get several Public Safety Devil Hunters, which includes Tamaoki.
